target_provenance: Automatic skeleton-junction correspondences from camera images, not independent DIC/FEM ground truth.
mask_policy: Only gated one-to-one, unambiguous observed matches are true. Missing targets are zero placeholders. Low-coverage frames masked in training NPZ.
split_policy: All versions, crops and frame subsets of one physical experiment must share lineage_id and one dataset split.
parallel_edge_policy: All edge polylines retained losslessly in packed graph archive; phase surrogate consumes one adjacency per node pair.
coordinate_convention: x=column/right, y=row/down, pixels in original image coordinates

loading_annotation.method: Median row intensity over central width; top bright-material front requires three consecutive rows above max(20,40% band maximum), lower liner is local row-intensity maximum. Median-filter21frames. Start=first50frame run at least2px below initial100frame median height; end=last minimum-height plateau frame before>=2px visible rebound. Initial row search bands and endpoint contact sheets visually reviewed.
loading_annotation.limitations: Retrospective image-only phase convention, not load, strain, physical timestamp calibration, or original author annotation. Onset carries pixel/threshold uncertainty; max-compression plateau end is defined operationally.

training_admission_reason: Final loading endpoint not observed; right-censored recording retained as graphs/tracks only.
intermediate_graph_archive_note: Reproducible intermediate retained locally; regenerate with image curation before repacking.
